_note: PIP's lines and card words by id. need.*: the advisor's lines (sandbox/advisor.gd), each naming the fix; panel.*: the power panel's card, each gain and lose saying what the switch does to the meters; report.*: the Mission 1 report card. Entries still reading 'TBD at event' are not used. ui/game_hud.gd say(id) shows one; an id missing here shows 'TBD at event: <id>' too.
failing_o2_kg: No air left for the crew to breathe.
failing_water_kg: No water left for the crew to drink.
failing_food_kg: No food left for the crew to eat.
failing_battery_pct: The battery is empty. The base gets cold.
failing_suit_air_min: Your suit air is gone. Get indoors!
mission_lost: Mission lost. Here is what went wrong.
report.title: Mission 1 complete!
report.line1: Ten sols on Mars. The crew is safe!
report.line2: Every choice had a cost. You kept going.
report.line3: The storm goes on. Ready for more?
need.air_out: *No suit air*! Run indoors and fill up!
need.leak: *Leak*! Turn the valve by the air maker!
need.dusty: *Dusty suit*! Brush it off in HAB 1.
need.devil: *Dust devil*! Brush your suit in HAB 1.
need.tired: You are tired. Finish up, then *sleep*.
need.blackout: *Blackout*! Switch machines off at HAB 1's panel.
need.power_low: *Power* low! Switch something off in HAB 1.
need.supply_low: *Supplies* low! Check the panel in HAB 1.
need.health_low: *Crew health* low! Eat, drink, then sleep.
panel.title: Power panel
panel.o2_maker.on_lose: it uses up water and Power
panel.greenhouse.on_gain: salad later: a Crew health boost
panel.heater.on_gain: a warm base for the crew
panel.heater.off_lose: a colder base for the crew
sol1.weigh_less: Whoa! Mars pulls *0.38* as hard as Earth!
sol1.meter_power: *Power*: sun and reactor fill it, machines drain.
sol1.meter_life: *Life support*: the crew's air, water, food.
sol1.meter_health: *Crew health* is you: air, water, food, sleep.
sol1.needs: Now look after *you*. Back to HAB 1!
sol1.drink: Now *drink*. Thirst pulls Crew health down.
sol1.eat: Then *eat*. Hunger pulls it down too.
sol1.sunlight_power: Our power comes from this *small sun*.
sol1.every_choice: *Power is short* today. Every choice costs something.
sol1.follow_me: Follow me! Our garden is this way.
sol1.air_tanks: Your air came *from Earth*, in these *tanks*.
sol1.air_maker: This makes more. It drinks *water and power*.
sol1.garden: *Three more days* of light, then salad!
check.sol1.q: Where does our air come from today?
choice.sol1.maker_lose: it uses up water and Power
choice.sol1.garden_gain: salad later: a Crew health boost
sol1.keys_ad: Now A and D: walk left and right!
sol1.key_s: S walks you back. Try it!
sol1.look_mouse: Your turn: look all around you!
sol1.follow_solar: Follow me to the solar wings!
sol1.follow_o2: Follow me to the air maker!
nag.sad: Beep... PIP is waiting for you.
sol2.follow_wings: Follow me to the solar wings!
sol2.see_dust: Night wind dropped *dust* on the wings.
sol2.brush: Press the button. The *wiper* does the rest!
sol2.your_call: One *row* clean. Five dusty. Your call.
sol2.to_reactor: The reactor is far. Take the rover!
sol2.reactor: It works *day, night and in storms*.
check.sol2.q: Why did the power drop overnight?
sol3.meet_outside: Morning! Meet me outside. Garden day!
sol3.plant: Your turn: plant the *seed tray* here!
check.sol3.q: What do our plants give us?
sol3.vitamins: Plants give *vitamins and smiles*, not most food.
sleep.when_ready: Explore! Sleep in HAB 1 when you're ready.
sleep.day_done: Today's work is done! Rest in HAB 1.
sleep.not_yet: Not sleepy yet! Finish today's tasks first.
deadline.sunset: The sun sets soon. Finish your tasks!
deadline.night: Night is here. Let's finish our tasks!
deadline.late: It's late, Commander. Let's finish up!
deadline.dawn: We worked all night! Finish, then sleep.
storm.dark: The storm makes it dark. Stay near base!
storm.panels: Dust blocks the sun. Our panels barely work.
hint.suit_lights: Your helmet lights. Switch them anytime.
hint.autopilot: Drop a *pin* on the map. I'll drive!
sol4.call_earth: Ask Earth a question: *radio* in HAB 1.
sol4.eleven_min: A message takes about *11 minutes* each way.
sol4.valve: Alarm! The *tank* is dropping! Check your handbook!
nag.s4_valve: The valve is beside the air maker!
sol4.no_wait: Leak stopped! Earth was *too far* to help.
sol4.reply_soon: Earth's answer is on its way.
sol4.reply_home: Earth answered! Their reply took the trip too.
check.sol4.q: Why couldn't Earth help with the alarm?
check.sol4.a: The answer takes too long to arrive
sol5.morning: Morning! Let's enjoy a quiet day.
sol5.hurry: Press *Shift* once to hurry. It burns air.
sol5.half_dose: Water walls cut the dose in *half*.
sol5.xrays: Outside, this storm is like *30 chest X-rays*.
sol5.decide: The storm lasts all day. Stay or go?
choice.sol5.stay_gain: half the dose: Crew health drops less
choice.sol5.stay_lose: the wings stay dusty: less Power
choice.sol5.go_lose: the full dose: Crew health drops more
sol5.sleep_hint: It's decided! Sleep in HAB 1 when ready.
sol6.quiet: Three quiet sols ahead. Let's skip them!
sol6.dustier: The wings got dustier while we waited.
sol9.plan: Field trip! Press *M* to open the map.
sol9.far: Find Mont Mercou. *M* closes the map.
sol9.drive: Off we go to Mont Mercou!
sol9.walk_back: *8.8 km*: if the rover breaks, we walk.
sol9.sample: Find a *flag* and pick up its pebble.
sol9.curiosity: An *old friend* lives in this crater.
check.sol9.q: Why is Mont Mercou a safe trip?
check.sol9.a: We could walk home if the rover broke
sol9.home: Great sample! Ride home: the rover's *back door*.
task.s9_plan: Plan the trip on the map
sol10.m1_done: Mission 1 done! Check your handbook log.
task.s12_storm: Find out what happened to the sky
sol12.outside: Commander! Come outside. Look at the sky!
sol12.dark: Look all around. Where did the sun go?
sol12.storm: A *dust storm*! The dust hides the sun.
sol12.wings: Our solar wings make *almost nothing* now.
sol12.choose: Power is short. What gets it today?
choice.sol12_power: Storm power for one: heat, air or plants?
choice.sol12.heat_lose: no spare air, no plant light
choice.sol12.maker_lose: a colder base, no plant light
choice.sol12.garden_lose: a colder base, no spare air
sol12.reactor: The *reactor* keeps working, even in storms.
sol12.planet: Some dust storms cover *all of Mars*!
check.sol10.q: Why do the wings make almost nothing now?
task.s13_dust: Brush the dust off your suit
sol13.morning: Morning! Meet me outside. Mind the dust!
sol13.brush: Dusty suit! Use the *brush* by the hatch.
sol13.toxic: Mars dust is likely toxic to breathe.
sol13.why: So we brush it off before coming in.
sol13.skip: The storm goes on. Let's skip four sols.
sol17.ripe: Let's check our garden! Follow me!
sol17.pick: Is the lettuce ready? Try the *tray*!
sol17.salad: Salad grows only while the garden is *lit*.
sol18.quiet: Two more dusty sols. Let's skip them!
sol20.plan: Big trip! Find Curiosity on the map.
sol20.far: It's 14.3 km away. Close the map.
sol20.ring: Too far to walk if the rover breaks!
sol20.board: Climb in! It's a long drive.
sol20.drive: Off we go! 14.3 km to Curiosity.
sol20.touch: Look, but never touch. It's still working!
sol20.archived: Its real spot on sol 5070, archived data.
sol20.lake: Curiosity found Gale once held a lake.
sol20.life: It found what life needs. Not life itself.
sol20.home: Time to go. Back into the rover!
sol21.quiet: Five calm sols of packing. Skip ahead!
sol26.lift: Going home soon! Lift the sample case.
sol26.limit: Our rocket carries only 100 kg of cargo.
sol26.carry: Carry it to the rocket. Walk steady!
sol26.set: Set it down by the rocket.
sol26.suits: Dusty suits stay here. We fly clean.
sol26.skip: Last sols on Mars. Skip to launch day!
sol31.year: Now the trip home takes about a year.
sol31.labs: Labs on Earth will study your rocks!
